layman_headline: The market just had a massive rally — now it's catching its breath, and so should we.
layman_explanation: Almost everything in crypto surged 20-65% over the past week, driven by a short squeeze and renewed institutional interest. Right now most coins are pulling back 2-8% in a healthy cooldown. Our Solana position is up nearly 6% and approaching its profit target, while XRP is down 6% after an overheated 46% weekly rally. Every swing candidate on the watchlist is either overbought or has already made its big move, making a new entry risky right now.
layman_action: Hold current positions. SOL is working toward its $100 target — let it run. Watch XRP closely — if it drops to $1.30, the stop-loss triggers and we exit. Don't chase any of the coins that already ran 40-80% this week.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates present poor risk/reward for new entries. PUMP (RSI 86, +84% 7d), ZRO (+59% 7d, +24% 24h), TRUMP (+76% 7d but -17% 24h reversal), and LIT (RSI 75, +39% 7d) are all extended. BTC dominance at 59.2% continues to suppress alt season conditions. The Fear & Greed index dropped from 71 to 66 intraday, suggesting the greed impulse is fading. SOL at $92.36 is consolidating well above its $77 stop and within striking distance of its $100 target. XRP at $1.46 is concerning with a -7.8% daily drop after a parabolic +46% week, but remains above the $1.30 stop-loss with room to recover. No new position is warranted until we see a genuine pullback to support or a fresh catalyst.
risk_factors: XRP's sharp -7.8% daily reversal after a 46% weekly run could accelerate into a deeper correction toward our $1.30 stop
BTC dominance at 59.2% and rising could further suppress altcoin performance across the portfolio
The Fear & Greed shift from 71 to 66 may signal the start of a broader risk-off move after this squeeze-driven rally
watch_list: XRP price action around the $1.40 support level — a break below signals trouble for our position
SOL approaching $95-100 zone — watch for volume confirmation to take profit near target
ZEC momentum after the Grayscale spot ETF filing — could offer a pullback entry if it cools to $650-700 range
market_context: The crypto market just experienced a powerful short-squeeze rally with BTC up 20.5% and alts up 20-65% weekly. A broad 2-8% daily pullback is underway as the market digests gains, with Fear & Greed cooling from 71 to 66.
context_banner: Post-squeeze consolidation phase — protect gains on existing positions and wait for pullbacks before adding new exposure.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed dropped from 71 to 66 intraday, suggesting the greed impulse that drove the rally is fading — not ideal for new entries.
PUMP RSI at 86 and LIT at 75 confirm the swing candidates are overbought; no oversold bounce setups available this cycle.
Zcash jumped 48% to $800+ on Grayscale spot ETF filing — a major catalyst, but the move is already priced in at current levels.
Ray Dalio recommending Bitcoin and BTC seeking support near $77K provides macro tailwind but doesn't create a specific altcoin entry opportunity.
XRP volume at $6.9B is elevated but accompanies a -7.8% daily drop — distribution pattern suggesting smart money is taking profit after the 46% weekly surge.
